Fibre and cable manufacturing.name: Fibre, cable and passive gear makers
Fibre and cable manufacturing.description: These companies make optical fibre, telecom and networking cables and passive products, selling to operators, government projects and enterprises. Their revenue comes from product sales, and they are set apart by making the physical cabling rather than active electronics.

extra.name: Telecom infrastructure services and EPC
extra.description: These companies install, commission, maintain and optimise telecom networks, towers and related power systems for operators and equipment makers. They earn project and service fees, often with a solar or energy sideline.

Enterprise connectivity and messaging.name: Business connectivity and network capacity providers
Enterprise connectivity and messaging.description: These companies sell managed connectivity, international capacity and network services to businesses and service providers, running their own networks. They earn from subscriptions, usage charges and contracts, and what sets this layer apart is its focus on enterprise and wholesale customers rather than consumers.
